clause: Page/spread container model + multi-page island spreads [STU-LAY-001,STU-LAY-002]

scope.summary: Implement the layout page/spread model over the canonical StudioPageSpread primitive (never fork): a layout StudioDocument holds an ordered set of StudioPageSpread containers; facing-pages documents pair pages across a binding spine and non-facing hold single-page spreads; the spread is the unit of parent-page application, spanning-object placement, and imposition. Multi-page (island) spreads MUST hold >2 pages up to a document-configured max of at least ten (gatefold/trifold/accordion), with per-document and per-spread allow-shuffle flags controlling whether repagination reflows pages into/out of a spread; disabling shuffle preserves the island during page insert/delete. Applied through studio-engine LayoutEngine; typed command + studio.layout events.
acceptance_criteria: StudioPageSpread ordered set with facing/non-facing + island >2 pages (max>=10) + per-doc/per-spread allow-shuffle; no forked layout doc model
proof_targets: Argus pages-navigator inspect; island-spread + allow-shuffle runtime test
expected_tests: live: island spread holds >2 pages up to configured max; allow-shuffle=false preserves island on page insert/delete
test: facing vs non-facing spread pairing round-trips on StudioPageSpread

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Pages, spreads & island spreads

risk_if_missed: No spread container model; all page-layout MTs blocked; island/fold formats impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
